## In Tibetan: *The Tantra Entitled The String of Precious Pearls*.[^T01-001][^CH01-G000007][^CH01-G000008][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-001]

<a id="mtp-000006"></a>
I bow to the Bhagavān, whose very identity is awareness, who has no delusion.[^T01-002][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-001][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-011]

<a id="mtp-000007"></a>
At one time when I taught thus:[^T01-003][^CH01-G000010][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-001]

<a id="mtp-000008"></a>
“Ah! Listen, you great ones whose very identity is delusion! Before my nonexistence, there was awareness free from delusion, called ‘that which has the identity of delusion.’[^T01-002][^T01-004][^CH01-G000014][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-001][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-012][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-013][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-014][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-015]

<a id="mtp-000009"></a>
> [source_metadata] [Printed page 419.][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-001][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-002][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-005]

<a id="mtp-000010"></a>
From that—from that not being pure—this great magical display of appearance arose on a vast scale; it dawned in individual objects untainted by delusion.[^T01-005][^T01-016][^CH01-G000016][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-001][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-016]

<a id="mtp-000011"></a>
At that time, the king that forms appearance arose as many conceptual thoughts of appearance through awareness that distinguishes appearance into classes.[^T01-006][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-001][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-017][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-018]

<a id="mtp-000012"></a>
I teach [this] as the supreme means of turning awareness back to the Ground in the realm of appearances of delusion. Listen in the three good ways.”[^T01-007][^CH01-G000021][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-001][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-019][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-020]

<a id="mtp-000013"></a>
> [source_metadata] [Printed page 420.][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-001][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-002][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-006]

<a id="mtp-000014"></a>
Then the Lord of Secrets, having understood the meaning of what was spoken, said:[^T01-008][^CH01-G000023][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-001][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-021]

<a id="mtp-000015"></a>
“Thus did I hear at one time. In the sublime palace undivided into parts, in the maṇḍala of the heart (citta),[^T01-003][^T01-009][^CH01-G000026][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-001][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-022][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-023][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-024]

<a id="mtp-000016"></a>
there were the embodiment of awareness’s sharp vajra, the embodiment of awareness’s vajra chains, the embodiment of awareness’s self-appearance, the embodiment of awareness left as it is, the embodiment of unobstructed awareness, and the embodiment of awareness’s naked appearance. All of these, too, had not moved from the embodiment of the essence of awareness.[^T01-010][^T01-011][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-001][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-025][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-026][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-027][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-028][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-029][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-030][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-031]

<a id="mtp-000017"></a>
There were also an inconceivable retinue of essence—white and red, yellow and green and dark blue, and so forth—and an inconceivable inner retinue of self-appearance.[^T01-011][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-001][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-031][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-032][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-033][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-034]

<a id="mtp-000018"></a>
> [source_metadata] [Printed page 421.][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-001][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-002][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-007]

<a id="mtp-000019"></a>
The outer retinue of objects was as follows: the Tathāgata family, the vajra family, the precious-jewel family, the lotus family, and the family free from doing; the wrathful Vajrapāṇi, Hayagrīva, and the Lord of Death of primordial knowing; hosts of ḍākinīs of action, and others beyond measure.[^T01-012][^T01-016][^T01-010][^T01-011][^CH01-G000042][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-001][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-034][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-035][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-036][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-037][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-038][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-039][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-040][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-076][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-077]

<a id="mtp-000020"></a>
There were the six sages, the retinue that tames appearances in outer objects, and inconceivable emanation embodiments that tame beings.[^T01-011][^T01-013][^T01-016][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-001][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-041][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-042]

<a id="mtp-000021"></a>
The retinue of delusion that apprehends was as follows: ignorance, ordinary mind, the mental faculty, the five afflictions,[^T01-014][^T01-011][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-001][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-043][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-044][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-045][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-046][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-078]

<a id="mtp-000022"></a>
> [source_metadata] [Printed page 422.][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-001][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-002][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-008]

<a id="mtp-000023"></a>
the apprehending subject, conceptual thought, nonvirtue, and so forth.[^T01-014][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-001][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-065][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-066][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-067]

<a id="mtp-000024"></a>
Its retinue of appearance was as follows: objects, knowing, mindfulness, that which sees, that which hears, that which smells, that which tastes, that which forms, forms, sounds, smells, tastes, tangible objects, phenomena, and so forth.[^T01-006][^T01-015][^T01-016][^T01-011][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-001][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-047][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-048][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-049][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-050][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-051][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-052][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-053][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-054][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-068][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-069][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-070][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-071][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-072][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-073][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-074][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-075][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-079]

<a id="mtp-000025"></a>
There were gods, asuras, gandharvas, and an inconceivable retinue of bodhisattvas;[^T01-011][^T01-017][^CH01-G000078][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-001][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-054][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-055][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-056]

<a id="mtp-000026"></a>
Vinaya, Sūtra, Abhidharma, and so forth;[^T01-017][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-001][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-056][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-057][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-058]

<a id="mtp-000027"></a>
viewing [things] as a perishing aggregate; hearers, solitary victors, bodhisattvas, Kriyā, and Upa;[^T01-017][^T01-018][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-001][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-059][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-060][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-061][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-062][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-063]

<a id="mtp-000028"></a>

<a id="mtp-000029"></a>
Yoga, and, on the inner side, Mahā, Anu, Ati, and so forth. Appearing as retinues of innumerable kinds, they dwelt together.”[^T01-011][^T01-017][^T01-019][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-001][^MTP-AUDIT-C01-064]

## Chapter 2

[Fixed chapter release](https://github.com/Lotus-King-Translation/Mu-Tig-Phreng-Ba/tree/translate-ch02-v1)

<a id="mtp-000031"></a>
> [source_metadata] [Electronic chapter marker 2.][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-004]

<a id="mtp-000032"></a>
Then the wrathful ones of the three families, the Lord of Secrets and the others, addressed the Bhagavān, the sovereign in whom all delusion is pure, in these words:[^T02-001][^CH02-G000099][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-001][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-007][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-008][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-009][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-056]

<a id="mtp-000033"></a>
“O, O Bhagavān, embodiment without delusion!  
For the sentient beings of saṃsāra in the three realms,  
if delusion is reversed, how is it reversed?  
Please tell us!”[^T02-001][^T02-002][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-001][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-010][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-011][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-056]

<a id="mtp-000034"></a>
Then that Bhagavān Vajrasattva  
spoke to the close retinue:[^T02-001][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-001]

<a id="mtp-000035"></a>
“Ah! Listen, Lord of Secrets.  
Although there is no delusion in the Ground at the beginning,  
there is delusion in sentient beings’ conceptual minds.  
If, then, one reaches the meaning of the sap  
of awareness’s primordial knowing,[^T02-001][^T02-002][^T02-003][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-001][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-012][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-013][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-014][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-015][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-056]

<a id="mtp-000036"></a>
> [source_metadata] [Printed page 424.][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-005]

<a id="mtp-000037"></a>
delusion is reversed in the initial Ground.  
Self-awareness’s primordial knowing is difficult to realize.  
In the Ground, [there is] an essence endowed with non-conceptuality.  
The means of conclusively determining delusion:  
spread ignorance and saṃsāra into [unresolved: འདས་ཤེས].[^T02-001][^T02-002][^T02-003][^T02-004][^T02-005][^T02-014][^CH02-G000117][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-002][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-016][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-019][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-020][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-021][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-022][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-057]

<a id="mtp-000038"></a>
Always look at the vajra chains.  
Carry whatever appears into the expanse of awareness.  
Leave self-awareness at its initial threshold.  
Ignorance itself [is cut] at the root;  
the appearance of primordial knowing dawns without abiding.[^T02-004][^T02-006][^T02-007][^T02-012][^T02-016][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-002][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-017][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-023][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-024][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-025][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-026][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-027][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-057]

<a id="mtp-000039"></a>
If delusion is reversed, it is reversed in the mother.  
The appearance of primordial knowing appears to the child in the intermediate state.[^T02-002][^T02-008][^CH02-G000124][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-002][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-018][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-028]

<a id="mtp-000040"></a>
Ascertain the root of ordinary mind—the expanse of primordial knowing.  
Trace ignorance to its source—the vajra chains.  
Cut the flow of the five gates—primordial knowing is clear.  
Open the seeing of awareness:  
[it] becomes empty appearance.[^T02-006][^T02-009][^T02-015][^T02-020][^T02-025][^CH02-G000128][^CH02-G000129][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-002][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-029][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-030][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-031][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-032][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-057]

<a id="mtp-000041"></a>
Bring forth the object of delusory appearance—awareness itself.  
Cut the flow of mindfulness—the state of the dharma embodiment.  
Extract saṃsāra’s quintessence—the three embodiments are clear.[^T02-001][^T02-009][^T02-010][^T02-015][^T02-020][^T02-025][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-002][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-003][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-033][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-034][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-035][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-036][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-037][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-058]

<a id="mtp-000042"></a>
> [source_metadata] [Printed page 425.][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-006]

<a id="mtp-000043"></a>
Empty and without substance, beautiful with clarity;  
sum up the five poisons—the state of medicine.  
The cause of darkness exhausted—the lamp itself.  
The cause of delusion exhausted—primordial knowing as companion.  
The embodiment of clarity blazes—the nondual state.  
Insentience and awareness are nondual; saṃsāra is cleared away.  
The primordial knowing of meaning returns to the Ground,  
of the nonduality of the ultimate and the conventional—[attachment unresolved].[^T02-001][^T02-002][^T02-011][^T02-025][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-003][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-038][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-039][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-040][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-041][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-042][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-043][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-044][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-045][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-058]

<a id="mtp-000044"></a>
Ah! Listen, King Hayagrīva.  
Bring forth the abiding of ordinary mind—primordial knowing itself.  
Conditioned appearance is without an object, all at once.  
As for the place of reversal where delusion is reversed:  
everything is cleared away in the vajra chains.  
In the maṇḍala of the object without mindfulness,  
free from differentiating conceptualization, the great continuum is clear.[^T02-001][^T02-002][^T02-006][^T02-010][^T02-012][^T02-016][^T02-025][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-003][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-046][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-047][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-048][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-049][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-050][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-051][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-052][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-058]

<a id="mtp-000045"></a>
However many appearances of mindfulness there are,  
since they are the cause of great delusion,  
in the space where mindfulness is cleared away,  
reverse that very delusion.[^T02-002][^T02-010][^T02-020][^T02-021][^T02-025][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-003][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-053][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-054][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-055][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-058][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-074]

<a id="mtp-000046"></a>
> [source_metadata] [Printed page 426.][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-059][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-060]

<a id="mtp-000047"></a>
Within the appearance of the object of the nature of phenomena,  
however many entities of thinking there are,  
since they are the cause of delusion and ignorance,  
in awareness without thinking,  
reverse that very [delusion] with the eye of meaning.[^T02-002][^T02-013][^T02-017][^T02-018][^T02-020][^T02-021][^T02-022][^T02-025][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-059][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-075][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-076][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-077][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-078][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-079][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-080]

<a id="mtp-000048"></a>
Within the appearance of the vajra chains,  
whatever conceptual thoughts of the apprehending subject there are,  
since those themselves are delusion in actuality,  
investigate with discerning knowing that brings realization,  
and look at the object of self-appearance.  
The root of all phenomena  
does not go beyond the two: mindfulness and awareness.[^T02-006][^T02-010][^T02-014][^T02-023][^T02-024][^T02-025][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-059][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-081][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-082][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-083][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-084]

<a id="mtp-000049"></a>
Ah! Listen, you King of the Lord of Death.  
Through the light [uncertain: བར་བས] of self-awareness’s primordial knowing,  
the very essence of the king of realization—  
the embodiment of basic space and vajra chains—  
since there is no distraction from that,  
is taught as the great realization of continuity.[^T02-001][^T02-004][^T02-006][^T02-009][^T02-014][^T02-015][^T02-020][^T02-025][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-059][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-067][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-085][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-086][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-087][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-088][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-089][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-090][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-091][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-092]

<a id="mtp-000050"></a>
As for the appearances in the conceptual mind that recalls,[^T02-010][^T02-016][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-059][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-093]

<a id="mtp-000051"></a>
> [source_metadata] [Printed page 427.][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-061][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-062]

<a id="mtp-000052"></a>
look at the embodiment of the king of awareness.  
Awareness, the unchanging embodiment of primordial knowing,  
floats in the self-clear object of the nature of phenomena.  
Abiding in the empty object of the nature of phenomena,[^T02-012][^T02-016][^T02-025][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-061][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-094][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-095][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-096][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-097][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-098][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-099]

<a id="mtp-000053"></a>
> [source_annotation] [Source annotation:] In primordial knowing that is beyond the entity of emptiness.[^T02-013][^T02-017][^T02-018][^T02-022][^T02-025][^CH02-G000178][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-061][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-068]

<a id="mtp-000054"></a>
the appearance of embodiment is inconceivable.  
In the non-arising nature of phenomena of appearance,  
the non-arising nature of phenomena of the three embodiments  
is beyond thinking; since it is not apprehended as an entity,  
it appears now and arises like the five lights.[^T02-013][^T02-014][^T02-016][^T02-017][^T02-018][^T02-022][^T02-025][^CH02-G000183][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-061][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-069][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-100][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-101][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-102][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-103]

<a id="mtp-000055"></a>
‘The appearance of awareness is clear light’[^T02-019][^CH02-G000184][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-061][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-104][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-105]

<a id="mtp-000056"></a>
[The source continues with the abbreviation “from the words …”; its intervening scope is unresolved.][^T02-019][^CH02-G000185][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-061][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-070]

<a id="mtp-000057"></a>
Various forms of clinging are self-liberated.  
The appearance of the dharma embodiment itself  
is beyond the phenomena of recalling and thinking.  
Since it arises naturally from the basic space of the nature of phenomena,  
differentiating conceptualization’s own knot is liberated.  
Since doing and the doer do not appear in continuity,[^T02-009][^T02-010][^T02-013][^T02-015][^T02-019][^T02-020][^T02-021][^T02-024][^T02-025][^CH02-G000188][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-061][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-071][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-106][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-107][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-108][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-109][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-110][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-111][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-112][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-113]

<a id="mtp-000058"></a>
> [source_metadata] [Printed page 428.][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-063][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-064]

<a id="mtp-000059"></a>
the primordial knowing of delusion, in the mother: [unresolved: ཞ].[^T02-020][^CH02-G000193][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-063][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-072][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-114]

<a id="mtp-000060"></a>
Since naturally arising primordial knowing is without a self,  
its essence arises as vajra chains.  
Self-appearance without an apprehending subject,  
not held by an apprehended object, is like the moon in water.  
Unobstructed self-liberation  
is like a great garuḍa soaring in space.  
Without projection or gathering being done, [it is] liberated in its own place.[^T02-006][^T02-014][^T02-020][^T02-021][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-063][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-115][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-116][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-117][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-118]

<a id="mtp-000061"></a>
The essence of awareness itself  
is liberated in a state without projection or gathering.  
The self-appearance of the dharma embodiment  
merely appears directly;  
it is beyond the mental faculty that recalls entities.  
Every appearance as a characteristic, without exception,  
attains the non-arising dharma embodiment.[^T02-010][^T02-013][^T02-017][^T02-018][^T02-021][^T02-022][^T02-023][^T02-025][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-063][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-119][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-120][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-121][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-122][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-123][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-124][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-125][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-126][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-127][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-128]

<a id="mtp-000062"></a>
Emaho!  
Since awareness’s primordial knowing has no appearance,  
the appearance of insentient matter does not obscure me.  
Since the empty nature of phenomena has no object,  
I do not abide in emptiness.  
Since apprehending as characteristics is pure in actuality,  
I do not abide in the phenomena of the apprehending subject.[^T02-012][^T02-014][^T02-016][^T02-022][^T02-023][^T02-024][^T02-025][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-063][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-129][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-130][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-131][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-132][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-133][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-134]

<a id="mtp-000064"></a>
Since [I] arise naturally through great discerning knowing,  
I do not abide in the teachings of the scriptural collections.  
Since for me there is neither virtue nor wrongdoing,  
I do not abide in the phenomena of saṃsāra.”[^T02-001][^T02-012][^T02-016][^T02-024][^T02-025][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-065][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-135][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-136][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-137][^MTP-AUDIT-C02-138]

## Chapter 3

[Fixed chapter release](https://github.com/Lotus-King-Translation/Mu-Tig-Phreng-Ba/tree/translate-ch03-v1)

<a id="mtp-000066"></a>
> [source_metadata] [Electronic chapter marker 3.][^MTP-AUDIT-C03-005]

<a id="mtp-000067"></a>
Then Hayagrīva, king of the wrathful ones, petitioned in these words:[^T03-001][^T03-024][^CH03-G000223][^MTP-AUDIT-C03-001][^MTP-AUDIT-C03-010][^MTP-AUDIT-C03-011][^MTP-AUDIT-C03-074]

<a id="mtp-000068"></a>
“O, O Bhagavān Vajradhara!  
The authoritative teaching of self-awareness’s great primordial knowing—  
please bestow [it], king of certainty!”[^T03-001][^T03-002][^T03-004][^T03-024][^MTP-AUDIT-C03-001][^MTP-AUDIT-C03-012][^T03-020]

<a id="mtp-000069"></a>
Then Bhagavān Vajradhara  
arose from the seat where he did not abide.  
Having uttered the word-formula [retained: སར་བ་འདུས་ཧ],  
he spoke to the assembled gathering:[^T03-001][^T03-003][^CH03-G000228][^CH03-G000229][^MTP-AUDIT-C03-001][^MTP-AUDIT-C03-009][^MTP-AUDIT-C03-013][^MTP-AUDIT-C03-014][^MTP-AUDIT-C03-015][^MTP-AUDIT-C03-016][^MTP-AUDIT-C03-074]

<a id="mtp-000070"></a>
“O, O, listen, assembled retinue!

Since the qualities of desire are primordially complete,

Since [one] has primordially arrived without moving the limbs,  
the path of going has been traversed from the beginning.  
Since spoken speech is inexpressible,

<a id="mtp-000135"></a>
Since the proliferating and gathering of nonexistence are primordially empty,  
[one] abides in great meditative concentration from the beginning.  
Since the stains are self-purified,  
[one] abides in great stainless unimpeded penetration.  
Because what is done has not arisen,  
[one is] free from doing and the doer from the outset.[^T04-002][^T04-023][^CH04-G000469][^CH04-G000470][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-126][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-149][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-150][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-151][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-152][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-153]

<a id="mtp-000136"></a>

<a id="mtp-000138"></a>
from the very beginning, [there is] only natural arising.

<a id="mtp-000139"></a>
Since saṃsāra, without cause, has already ceased,

<a id="mtp-000140"></a>
Then King Hayagrīva himself,

having become supremely astonished,

<a id="mtp-000143"></a>
Then that great Vajradhara,

<a id="mtp-000144"></a>
“Ema! If appearances such as those,

<a id="mtp-000145"></a>
Conceptual thoughts of good and bad  
are cultivation’s great river-expanse.

are yoga’s impartial view.  
All apprehending in hope and fear[^T04-104][^T04-105][^T04-106][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-132][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-175][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-176][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-177][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-178][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-179][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-223]

<a id="mtp-000147"></a>
is the result of pure penetration arising.[^T04-106][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-135][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-180]

<a id="mtp-000148"></a>
With the desire for Mahamudra to be manifest,

The path of going, as an object of focus, is the great line;

The wish to go is the posture itself;

<a id="mtp-000149"></a>
Whatever is spoken is a word of mantra.

<a id="mtp-000151"></a>
One’s own body is the vase;

Blood and serum are the waters themselves.

The empowerments appearing to oneself are bestowed;

<a id="mtp-000152"></a>
The desire to transgress is samaya;  
the desire to guard is bondage itself.  
The desire to liberate is deterioration;  
the desire for absence is the supreme sage.[^T04-111][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-138][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-199][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-200]

<a id="mtp-000153"></a>
Eating and drinking are approach;  
lying down and sitting are accomplishment.  
Formations are consecration itself.  
With the lungs and [retained: ལུང་པ], the mandala is accomplished.  
Things seen are signs of the gesture;

> [source_metadata] [Printed page 448.][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-140][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-142]

<a id="mtp-000155"></a>
Clear knowing-awareness is instruction;

Birth, aging, sickness, and death are the vital point of familiarization.

<a id="mtp-000156"></a>
Then the primordial-knowing ḍākinīs,  
being intensely joyful, delighted, and rejoicing,

<a id="mtp-000157"></a>
“O! If liberation free from delusion is like that,

<a id="mtp-000158"></a>
Vajradhara spoke:[^T04-101][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-141][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-217]

<a id="mtp-000159"></a>
“Since space itself is pervasive and empty,  
space itself is liberated as an entity.  
Since wind appears without an apprehended object,  
[it] is liberated as the work of gathering entities.  
Since fire is the ripener, the eater of offerings,[^T04-116][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-141][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-218][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-219][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-220][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-221][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-222][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-239]

<a id="mtp-000160"></a>
> [source_metadata] [Printed page 449.][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-225][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-226]

<a id="mtp-000161"></a>
[it] is liberated as moving and separating the refined portion and dregs.  
Since earth generates and supports,  
[it] is liberated as insubstantial, limitless emptiness.  
Since water gathers and moistens,  
[it] is liberated as the work of burning and ripening.[^T04-116][^T04-117][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-225][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-240][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-241][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-242][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-243]

<a id="mtp-000162"></a>
The wind of space is an entity;  
the fire of space gathers.  
The water of space burns.  
The earth of space opens room.

<a id="mtp-000163"></a>
The wind of wind is stable;  
the space of wind has great primordial radiance.  
The water of wind is swift;  
the fire of wind divides projection and gathering.  
Through wind, as for earth, [its] reflection is clear.[^T04-118][^T04-119][^T04-120][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-225][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-249][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-250][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-251][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-252][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-253]

<a id="mtp-000164"></a>
> [source_metadata] [Printed page 450.][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-227][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-228]

<a id="mtp-000165"></a>
The water of water is melodious sound.

The wind of water flows without attachment.  
The fire of water gathers.

<a id="mtp-000166"></a>
The fire of fire generates.  
The space of fire burns entities.  
The wind of fire makes [them] blaze.  
The water of fire destroys wood.  
The earth of fire holds.[^T04-118][^T04-121][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-227][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-259][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-260][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-261][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-262][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-263]

<a id="mtp-000167"></a>
The earth of earth pervades beings.  
The space of earth is the great vehicle.  
The wind of earth fills and empties.  
The water of earth generates entities.  
The fire of earth dries.[^T04-118][^T04-122][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-227][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-264][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-265][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-266][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-267][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-268]

<a id="mtp-000168"></a>
Through arising without determination,[^T04-123][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-227][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-237][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-269][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-270]

<a id="mtp-000169"></a>
> [source_metadata] [Printed page 451.][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-229][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-230]

<a id="mtp-000170"></a>
ordinary mind itself, appearing definitely, is liberated.  
All appearances that do not exist as form  
are liberated in the state without intrinsic nature.  
The formless are liberated by entities.  
Phenomena are liberated by phenomena;  
even absence is liberated by absence.  
One is liberated by one;  
through appearing as two, the two are liberated.”[^T04-123][^T04-124][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-229][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-271][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-272][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-273][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-274][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-275][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-276][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-277][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-278]

<a id="mtp-000171"></a>
Glorious Supreme Horse again petitioned:[^T04-101][^T04-125][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-229]

<a id="mtp-000172"></a>
“O Bhagavān Vajradhara!  
Since even the container-world has become liberated,

Or are all those liberated ones[^T04-101][^T04-115][^T04-126][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-229][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-279][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-280][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-281][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-282][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-283][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-284][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-285][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-286][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-287][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-288][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-289]

<a id="mtp-000173"></a>

<a id="mtp-000174"></a>
liberated without effort—or what?

are not reasonably to be liberated,

<a id="mtp-000175"></a>
The Bhagavān spoke:[^T04-101][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-231][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-295][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-296]

<a id="mtp-000176"></a>
“Liberation is not through effort;  
from the very primordial beginning, [one] abides liberated.[^T04-127][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-231][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-297][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-298]

<a id="mtp-000177"></a>
From the joining of means and discerning knowing,  
the very causes of father and mother,  
moved by the propelling wind,

<a id="mtp-000178"></a>
From the causes of the five elements, the seed  
arises distinctly from the object of emptiness.  
The bliss of the two, their absorption,  
is discerning knowing arisen from means.[^T04-128][^T04-129][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-231][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-305][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-306][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-307][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-308]

<a id="mtp-000179"></a>
> [source_metadata] [Printed page 453.][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-233][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-234]

<a id="mtp-000180"></a>
Entry into the enclosure of the womb  
is self-awareness arising as appearance from the ground.  
[It is] the measure of realization of seven groups of seven.  
Ten months—traversing the levels themselves.[^T04-130][^T04-135][^CH04-G000618][^CH04-G000619][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-233][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-309][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-310][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-311][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-312]

<a id="mtp-000181"></a>
Birth itself is arising as embodiment.  
The body’s growth is the object of ground-appearance.  
Abiding in the body is the ground.  
Aging is delusion clearing away.  
Sickness itself is the confidence of realization.  
Through death, [one] is liberated into the empty nature of phenomena.[^T04-131][^T04-135][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-233][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-313][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-314][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-315][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-316][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-317][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-318]

<a id="mtp-000182"></a>
Thus, sentient beings in form  
are primordially liberated without effort.  
Ema! Activity, thinking, transformation—appearance is liberated.

<a id="mtp-000183"></a>
> [source_metadata] [Printed page 454.][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-235][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-236]

<a id="mtp-000184"></a>
Unexamined by view, permanence and annihilation are liberated.  
Unbound by the result, one’s own body is liberated.  
Appearance is stamped with the primordial seal.”[^T04-133][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-235][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-324][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-325][^MTP-AUDIT-C04-326]

<a id="mtp-000185"></a>

## Chapter 5

> [source_metadata] [Electronic chapter marker 5.][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-002]

<a id="mtp-000187"></a>
Then the wrathful ones of the families petitioned in these words:[^T05-001][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-001][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-003]

<a id="mtp-000188"></a>
“O, O Bhagavān Vajradhara!  
What is the intrinsic nature of all buddhas?  
How does it abide in sentient beings?[^T05-001][^T05-002][^CH05-G000640][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-001][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-003][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-004][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-005][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-006]

<a id="mtp-000189"></a>
If that itself abides, delusion would be unfitting.  
As for the manner in which that delusion is reversed,  
by what and by what is it reversed?  
What is undeluded primordial knowing like?[^T05-002][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-001][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-003][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-007][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-008][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-009][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-010]

<a id="mtp-000190"></a>
If we have become [—],  
how is there twofold appearance in that?  
Lord, how is doubt dispelled?”[^T05-002][^CH05-G000645][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-001][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-003][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-011][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-012][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-013]

<a id="mtp-000191"></a>
> [source_metadata] [Printed page 455.][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-015]

<a id="mtp-000192"></a>
Vajradhara spoke:[^T05-001][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-014][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-016][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-017]

<a id="mtp-000193"></a>
“Supreme Lord of Secrets, holder of the vajra!  
The two—the Ground, one in essence; from distinction—  
abide in the unique enlightened intent without conceptual elaborations,  
endowed with the intrinsic nature of the sphere of great bliss:  
one mandala, lord of all buddhas.[^T05-001][^T05-003][^CH05-G000651][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-014][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-016][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-018][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-019][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-020][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-021][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-022]

<a id="mtp-000194"></a>
Through the primordial purity of essence itself,  
there is spontaneous presence in intrinsic nature itself.[^T05-004][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-014][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-016][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-023][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-024]

<a id="mtp-000195"></a>
Beyond grounds, directions, and divisions,  
there is no existence, nonexistence, or seeming appearance;  
there is no one, two, or object of enumeration.  
In great emptiness, [it] is established just as it settles.[^T05-004][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-014][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-016][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-025][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-026][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-027][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-028][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-030][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-031]

<a id="mtp-000196"></a>
> [source_metadata] [Printed page 456.][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-029]

<a id="mtp-000197"></a>
It is not the domain of scriptural transmission and reasoning;  
tantras and pith instructions do not indicate it.  
Through view, cultivation, and activity,  
its meanings do not become known.[^T05-005][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-028][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-030][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-032][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-033][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-034][^T05-L038]

<a id="mtp-000198"></a>
As for its meaning, there is no accomplishment of a result;  
through phenomena, that itself becomes obscured.  
It is not accomplished through thinking,  
nor can it be examined through discerning knowing.[^T05-005][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-028][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-030][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-035][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-036][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-037][^T05-L002][^T05-L004]

<a id="mtp-000199"></a>
Through generosity, ethical discipline, and patience,  
that itself is free from the results of harm and benefit.  
Through hearing, thinking, and cultivation,  
even if [it] is examined supremely, the meaning is not seen.[^T05-006][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-028][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-030][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-038][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-039][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-040][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-041][^T05-L004]

<a id="mtp-000200"></a>
There is no mandala in that;  
there is no deity, no seed of generation.  
What would one do with mantra and seals?  
There is no need to elaborate offerings and the like.  
Where are empowerment and commitments?[^T05-007][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-028][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-030][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-042][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-043][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-044][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-045][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-046]

<a id="mtp-000201"></a>
> [source_metadata] [Printed page 457.][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-048]

<a id="mtp-000202"></a>
There is no approach or accomplishment;  
there is no elaboration of wheels.  
There is no protection and no object of protection;  
[it] is beyond the domain of obstructing spirits and harm.[^T05-007][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-047][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-049][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-050][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-051][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-052][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-053][^T05-L038]

<a id="mtp-000203"></a>
It is that, and is also beings;  
it is ordinary mind and what arises from ordinary mind.  
It is many, and it is unique;  
I myself am saṃsāra and nirvāṇa.[^T05-008][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-047][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-049][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-054][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-055][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-056]

<a id="mtp-000204"></a>
It is gradual entry into mandalas and the like;  
it is phenomena and appears as phenomena.  
It is abiding, and it is liberation;  
it is sitting, lying down, and walking.  
It is life, and it is also cutting [life] off.[^T05-008][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-047][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-049][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-057][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-058][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-059][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-060][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-061][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-062][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-064][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-065][^T05-L001][^T05-L002]

<a id="mtp-000205"></a>
> [source_metadata] [Printed page 458.][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-063]

<a id="mtp-000206"></a>
The three worlds arise from that;  
[it] appears as deities, mantra, and seals.  
[It] arises as virtue and its result;  
the ten perfections, too, are that.[^T05-009][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-062][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-064][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-066][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-067][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-068][^T05-L001]

<a id="mtp-000207"></a>
The grounds and the qualities, too,  
all arise from that itself.  
Activity and cultivation itself,  
view and all the rest also arise;  
the vehicles in their greater and lesser stages, too,  
all arise from that.[^T05-009][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-062][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-064][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-069][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-070][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-071][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-072][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-073]

<a id="mtp-000208"></a>
In brief, however they appear,  
earth, water, fire, wind, and space—  
the great elements—arise from that.[^T05-010][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-062][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-064][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-074][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-075]

<a id="mtp-000209"></a>
Gods, demigods, and humans,  
hell beings, animals, and hungry ghosts[^T05-010][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-062][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-064][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-076][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-078][^T05-L025]

<a id="mtp-000210"></a>
> [source_metadata] [Printed page 459.][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-077]

<a id="mtp-000211"></a>
arise authentically from that great [one].[^T05-010][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-076][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-078][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-079]

<a id="mtp-000212"></a>
Desire, hatred, bewilderment,  
pride, jealousy, and the like—  
magical display arises from that itself.[^T05-010][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-076][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-078][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-080]

<a id="mtp-000213"></a>
Ignorance, ordinary mind, and mental faculties,  
aggregates, elements, and sense bases,  
the collections of consciousness,  
the five faculties and the like arise.[^T05-011][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-076][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-078][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-081][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-082][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-083]

<a id="mtp-000214"></a>
Sound, smell, taste,  
objects of touch, and objects of desire  
arise as its adornment.[^T05-012][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-076][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-078][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-084][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-085]

<a id="mtp-000215"></a>
Hollowness and insubstantiality,  
lack of a core and the like, too,  
arise as its expressiveness and play.[^T05-013][^CH05-G000721][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-076][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-078][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-086][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-087][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-088]

<a id="mtp-000216"></a>
The all-basis and the appropriated  
flesh, blood, lymph,  
bones, skin, and body hair—  
the assembled bodies arise from that.[^T05-014][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-076][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-078][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-089][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-090][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-091][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-092]

<a id="mtp-000217"></a>
Body, speech, and mental faculty,  
mental factors and the various afflictions—  
all arise from my own identity.[^T05-015][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-076][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-078][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-093][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-094][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-095][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-097][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-098]

<a id="mtp-000218"></a>
> [source_metadata] [Printed page 460.][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-096]

<a id="mtp-000219"></a>
Men, women, horses, and cattle—  
all forms arise from that.  
Eating, lying down, and sitting,  
the various actions, arise.[^T05-015][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-095][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-097][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-099][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-100][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-101][^T05-L005][^T05-L006]

<a id="mtp-000220"></a>
O lord of wrathful ones, in the nature of phenomena abiding in this way,  
there is no delusion from the beginning.  
The dharma embodiment, like space,  
is obscured by adventitious clouds of sentient beings.[^T05-001][^T05-016][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-095][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-097][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-102][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-103]

<a id="mtp-000221"></a>
Even the undeluded nature of phenomena  
is endowed with an adventitious manner of delusion.  
Momentary, together with causes and conditions,  
although it appears thus with regard to objects,[^T05-016][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-095][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-097][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-104][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-105][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-106][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-107][^T05-L003]

<a id="mtp-000222"></a>
in the primordial purity of the very beginning,  
one cannot even say “delusion.”  
Likewise, what could “undeluded” be?  
Therefore, delusion is pure from the beginning.[^T05-017][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-095][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-097][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-108][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-109][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-110]

<a id="mtp-000223"></a>
In that great Ground-appearance itself,  
because there is no designation as “ignorance,”[^T05-017][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-095][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-097][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-111][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-112][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-113][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-115][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-116]

<a id="mtp-000224"></a>
> [source_metadata] [Printed page 461.][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-114]

<a id="mtp-000225"></a>
there is no establishment as delusion.[^T05-017][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-113][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-115]

<a id="mtp-000226"></a>
Because “conceptual mind” is not imputed,  
there is not even the name of stain or delusion.  
Without the gathering of names and letters,  
there is no imputed delusion.[^T05-017][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-113][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-115][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-117][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-118][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-119]

<a id="mtp-000227"></a>
Because, as the name “phenomena,” [retained: དུམ་གྲགས་པས],  
there is not even the name of delusion imputed by the conceptual mind.  
Because it is not established as ordinary mind and mental faculty,  
the delusion that brings about movement is naturally absent.[^T05-018][^CH05-G000756][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-113][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-115][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-120][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-121][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-122][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-123][^T05-L002]

<a id="mtp-000228"></a>
Because there are no two stains, subtle and coarse,  
delusion as a condition of arising is naturally absent.  
Because doing and the doer are not two,  
where is the delusion of apprehending objects?[^T05-019][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-113][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-115][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-124][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-125][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-126][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-127][^T05-L007][^T05-L008]

<a id="mtp-000229"></a>
Because objects and faculties are not two,  
there is no delusion of apprehending objects.[^T05-019][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-113][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-115][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-128][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-129][^T05-L003]

<a id="mtp-000230"></a>
O great lord of wrathful ones, listen well!  
In the phenomena appearing as intrinsic nature,[^T05-001][^T05-019][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-113][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-115][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-130][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-131][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-132][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-134][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-135][^T05-L002]

<a id="mtp-000231"></a>
> [source_metadata] [Printed page 462.][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-133]

<a id="mtp-000232"></a>
because there are no stains, subtle and coarse are reversed;  
because there is no apprehended object and apprehending subject, delusion is reversed.  
Because there is no movement, karmic wind is reversed;  
because there is unimpeded penetration, entities are reversed.[^T05-020][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-132][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-134][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-136][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-137][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-138][^T05-L009][^T05-L010]

<a id="mtp-000233"></a>
Because there is clarity, emptiness is reversed;  
because [it] is complete from the beginning, the generation stage is reversed.  
Because there is no exertion, activity is reversed;  
because [it] is left without seeking, cultivation is reversed.[^T05-020][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-132][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-134][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-139][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-140][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-141][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-142][^T05-L011]

<a id="mtp-000234"></a>
Because there is self-liberation, appearance is reversed;  
because [it] appears manifestly, view is reversed.  
Because there are no words or phrases, designation is reversed;  
because [it] has never existed, clinging is reversed.[^T05-020][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-132][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-134][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-143][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-144][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-145][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-146]

<a id="mtp-000235"></a>
Because [it] has never been nonexistent, dependence on another is reversed;  
because there is nothing to apprehend, conceptual-mind imputation is reversed.  
Because [it] is unique, the limits of number are reversed.[^T05-020][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-132][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-134][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-147][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-148][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-149][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-272]

<a id="mtp-000236"></a>
> [source_metadata] [Printed page 463.][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-271][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-273]

<a id="mtp-000237"></a>
Because [it] pervades all, arising from another ceases;  
because there is self-arising, darkness clears.  
Because [it] is the core, [it] pervades as dharma embodiment;  
because [it] appears clearly, [it] expands as complete enjoyment embodiment.[^T05-021][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-150][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-151][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-152][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-153][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-272]

<a id="mtp-000238"></a>
Because mother and child meet, [it] arises as emanation embodiment;  
because [it] exists as a sign, [it] arises as means.  
Because [it] is beyond thinking, mindfulness clears;  
because there is no permanence or annihilation, philosophical tenets are complete.[^T05-021][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-154][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-155][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-156][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-157][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-272][^T05-L012]

<a id="mtp-000239"></a>
By gathering into [retained: བཅུང], awareness is clear;  
because there is self-liberation, [there is] leaving as it is, and  
the awareness of that very reversal,  
because it arises from itself, is called “liberated.”[^T05-022][^CH05-G000793][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-158][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-159][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-160][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-161][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-272][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-275]

<a id="mtp-000240"></a>
> [source_metadata] [Printed page 464.][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-274][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-276]

<a id="mtp-000241"></a>
Because [it] abides, [it] is called “pervading”;  
because there are no marks, [it] is called “empty.”  
Because there is no setting, [it] is called “arisen”;  
because there is no material encumbrance, [there is] unimpeded penetration.[^T05-023][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-162][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-163][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-164][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-165][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-275]

<a id="mtp-000242"></a>
Because [it] abides liberated, [it] is called “reversed”;  
because variety has cleared, [it] is called “purified.”  
Because [it] is not two, [it] is the single one;  
because [it] generates everything, [it] is called “cause.”[^T05-023][^CH05-G000803][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-166][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-167][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-168][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-169][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-275][^T05-L037]

<a id="mtp-000243"></a>
Because [it] is complete without remainder, [it] is the result itself;  
because objects of focus are pure, [it] is called “path.”  
Because delusion is exhausted, [it] is also scriptural transmission;  
because [it] abides primordially, [it] is called “continuum.”  
Because [it] can be indicated, [it] is pith instruction;  
because [it] is beyond number, [it] is called “reckoning.”[^T05-023][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-170][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-171][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-172][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-173][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-174][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-175][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-275]

<a id="mtp-000244"></a>
Such ordinary mind itself  
is like a jewel, fulfilling needs and desires;[^T05-024][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-176][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-177][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-275][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-278][^T05-L022]

<a id="mtp-000245"></a>
> [source_metadata] [Printed page 465.][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-277][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-279]

<a id="mtp-000246"></a>
like a treasury, containing all that is needed;  
like a mirror, where whatever is shown appears;  
like a stainless, clear crystal orb;  
various appearances—a brocade tent.[^T05-024][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-178][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-179][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-180][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-181][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-278][^T05-L022]

<a id="mtp-000247"></a>
Because there is no elaboration or withdrawal, [it] is like a great garuḍa;  
complete in the expressiveness of view, [it] is like a lion.  
Because [it] pervades with complete depth, [it] is like the ocean;  
naturally arising and liberated, [it] is like space.  
Because everything rests upon [it], [it] is like the earth;  
[it] is exceptionally exalted above all objects.[^T05-024][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-182][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-183][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-184][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-185][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-186][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-187][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-278][^T05-L014]

<a id="mtp-000248"></a>
Within awareness without cessation,  
because there is no delusion, there is no conceptual thought.  
Because there is primordial liberation, [it] is utterly exalted;  
because there is self-liberation, object-conditions are exhausted.  
Because there is naked liberation, appearances are pure.[^T05-025][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-188][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-189][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-190][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-191][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-192][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-278][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-281][^T05-L014][^T05-L023]

<a id="mtp-000249"></a>
> [source_metadata] [Printed page 466.][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-280][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-282]

<a id="mtp-000250"></a>
Because there is liberation from extremes, the four alternatives cease;  
because there is liberation of one, the many are emptied.[^T05-025][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-193][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-281]

<a id="mtp-000251"></a>
Since conditions are liberated through conditions,  
I do not depend on phenomena that are objects of focus.  
Since objects are liberated through objects,  
I do not depend on the two, apprehended object and apprehending subject.[^T05-026][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-194][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-195][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-196][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-197][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-281][^T05-L013][^T05-L015]

<a id="mtp-000252"></a>
When the cause itself is liberated through the cause,  
[there is] no dependence on saṃsāra and nirvāṇa, the two—[retained: ལང].  
When phenomena are liberated through phenomena,  
I do not depend on words of designation.[^T05-026][^CH05-G000838][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-198][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-199][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-200][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-201][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-281][^T05-L013][^T05-L015][^T05-L016][^T05-L039]

<a id="mtp-000253"></a>
When ordinary mind itself is liberated through ordinary mind,  
I do not depend on the conceptual mind that indicates.  
Just as stain is deluded through stain,  
that purity is liberated through purity.[^T05-026][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-202][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-203][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-204][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-281][^T05-L009]

<a id="mtp-000254"></a>
As poisons are neutralized by poison,  
iron is cleaved by iron,[^T05-027][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-205][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-281][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-284]

<a id="mtp-000255"></a>
> [source_metadata] [Printed page 467.][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-283][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-285]

<a id="mtp-000256"></a>
stones are broken by stone,  
and wood is burned by wood,  
each makes its own enemy itself;  
liberation does not come through an incompatible kind.[^T05-027][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-206][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-207][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-208][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-284][^T05-L013]

<a id="mtp-000257"></a>
Therefore, in awareness abiding in the Ground,  
because there is self-arising, appearance is complete;  
because there is natural arising, the Ground itself is complete;  
because there is self-appearance, objects too are complete.[^T05-028][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-209][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-210][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-211][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-212][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-284][^T05-L013]

<a id="mtp-000258"></a>
Because there is self-liberation, the Ground of delusion is complete;  
because there is self-purification, all paths are complete.  
Because there is self-awareness, what is to be known is complete;  
because there is self-pervasion, the result is complete.[^T05-028][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-213][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-214][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-215][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-284][^T05-L017]

<a id="mtp-000259"></a>
Because [it] is its own place, causes and conditions are complete;  
because [it] is realized by itself, the nature of phenomena is complete.  
Because there is self-reversal, saṃsāra and nirvāṇa are complete;  
because there is self-abiding, tantras and scriptural transmissions are complete.  
Because there is self-completeness, [it] is complete at one time.[^T05-028][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-216][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-217][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-218][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-284][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-287][^T05-L013][^T05-L016][^T05-L018]

<a id="mtp-000260"></a>
> [source_metadata] [Printed page 468.][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-286][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-288]

<a id="mtp-000261"></a>
Because there is self-knowing, oral instructions are complete;  
because there is self-resting, meditative stability is complete;  
because there is self-abiding, basic space is complete.[^T05-028][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-219][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-220][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-287]

<a id="mtp-000262"></a>
Emaho!  
The dharma embodiment of great self-completeness:  
because [it] is pure from the beginning, stains are exhausted;  
because [it] arose at the beginning, transmission is exhausted;  
because [it] is without a counterpart, [it] is beyond reckoning.[^T05-029][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-221][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-222][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-223][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-287][^T05-L009][^T05-L019]

<a id="mtp-000263"></a>
Without a cause of suffering—great bliss;  
without a cause of expression—beyond speech and thinking.  
Primordial self-awareness is completely pure awareness.  
Because outflows are exhausted, [it] is not materially encumbered;  
because [retained: དངོས་པོ་བཟོད], [it] abides empty.[^T05-029][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-224][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-225][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-226][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-227][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-287][^T05-L020][^T05-L021]

<a id="mtp-000264"></a>
The essence itself, not increased by the two,  
is beyond extremes because [it] is free from phenomena.  
Clear and free from conceptualization, movement clears;  
without the two, inert matter and awareness, the two accumulations are complete.[^T05-030][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-228][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-229][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-230][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-231][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-232][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-287][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-290][^T05-L015]

<a id="mtp-000265"></a>
> [source_metadata] [Printed page 469.][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-289][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-291]

<a id="mtp-000266"></a>
Without a rival counterpart—leaving as it is itself.  
Because that cannot be transformed through phrases,  
there are no contrived phrases; [it] pervades all.  
Without ordinary mind that thinks, [it] is free from mindfulness.[^T05-031][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-233][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-234][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-235][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-290]

<a id="mtp-000267"></a>
It is freshness itself—[retained: གཉུག་མའི་རང];  
supremely uncontrived, [it] abides authentically.  
With regard to what is to be known, [it] is established just as it settles;  
not before, not later, not from the beginning.[^T05-031][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-236][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-237][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-238][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-239][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-290][^T05-L024]

<a id="mtp-000268"></a>
[It] is not movement; mindfulness abides.  
The single ordinary mind that pervades all—  
philosophical limits complete—is the foremost portion;  
[it] is established at the beginning, middle, and end.[^T05-031][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-240][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-241][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-242][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-243][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-290][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-298][^T05-L040]

<a id="mtp-000269"></a>
The undeluded Ground abiding in this way—  
self-awareness, primordially [retained: འོད་རེགས་ལ]—  
the three embodiments are primordially complete, without being generated.[^T05-032][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-244][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-245][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-290][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-293]

<a id="mtp-000270"></a>
> [source_metadata] [Printed page 470.][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-292][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-294]

<a id="mtp-000271"></a>
The result abides of itself primordially;  
primordially, it cannot be contrived through phenomena.  
Primordially, it is free from being sustained by philosophical tenets;  
primordially, it is unstained by the five poisons.  
Where could there be gathering or separation of saṃsāra and nirvāṇa?[^T05-033][^CH05-G000902][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-246][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-247][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-248][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-249][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-250][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-293][^T05-L027]

<a id="mtp-000272"></a>
The face of clarity—how great its majesty!  
Appearance itself—how spontaneously beautiful!  
Pointing out the dharma embodiment—how lucidly joyful!  
The essence, unimpeded penetration—how spacious its interior![^T05-034][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-251][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-252][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-253][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-254][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-293]

<a id="mtp-000273"></a>
Intrinsic nature, all-pervading—how great its spread!  
Compassionate responsiveness, source of all—how great [retained: སྐྱོ]!  
Pervasion, primordial radiance—how clear its brilliance!  
Abiding, unobstructed—how swift its pace!  
Awareness’s own radiance—how clear its light![^T05-034][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-255][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-256][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-257][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-258][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-259][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-293][^T05-L031]

<a id="mtp-000274"></a>
> [source_metadata] [Printed page 471.][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-295][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-297]

<a id="mtp-000275"></a>
Emptiness, source of all—how wondrous!  
Leaving [it] without seeking—how long its continuity!  
Unarranged, naturally arising—how great its spread!  
Appearance and existence arise as the Ground—its height rises by stages.[^T05-035][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-260][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-261][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-262][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-296]

<a id="mtp-000276"></a>
Effortless self-liberation—how vast its extent!  
Great primordial realization—how skilled its turning!  
Endowed with five colors—how well painted!  
Completely pure appearance and existence—how even within![^T05-035][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-263][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-264][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-296][^T05-L031]

<a id="mtp-000277"></a>
Naturally arising clear light—how well arranged!  
Great Ground-appearance—how vast its capacity!  
The two, saṃsāra and nirvāṇa—how skillfully connected!  
Five embodiments and primordial knowing—how well arrayed in layers![^T05-035][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-265][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-266][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-267][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-268][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-296][^T05-L016]

<a id="mtp-000278"></a>
In the essence abiding as intrinsic nature,  
there are no buddhas and no sentient beings;  
there is no ignorance and no delusion.[^T05-036][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-269][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-270][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-296][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-299][^T05-L025]

<a id="mtp-000279"></a>
> [source_metadata] [Printed page 472.][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-398][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-399]

<a id="mtp-000280"></a>
There is no ordinary mind, nor is there mental faculty;  
there are no enemies, friends, or kin.  
There are no afflictions and no grasping at “I”;  
there is no going and no coming.[^T05-036][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-300][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-301][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-302][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-303][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-398][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-399][^T05-L026]

<a id="mtp-000281"></a>
There are no phenomena and no appearing as phenomena;  
there are no means, nor discerning knowing itself.  
There are no aggregates, nor elements;  
there are no objects, nothing to be apprehended.[^T05-036][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-304][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-305][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-306][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-307][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-398][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-399][^T05-L027][^T05-L028][^T05-L029]

<a id="mtp-000282"></a>
There are no faculties, nor objects;  
there is what is to be apprehended, and no apprehending subject.  
There are no embodiments, nor primordial knowing itself;  
there is no lord of knowing and what is to be known.[^T05-036][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-308][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-309][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-310][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-398][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-399][^T05-L029][^T05-L030]

<a id="mtp-000283"></a>
There is no light, nor color;  
there is no sound, no smell or the like.  
There is no desire and no clinging;  
there is no basic space, nor a measureless palace.  
There is no deity; [it] is beyond the object of offering.[^T05-037][^CH05-G000944][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-311][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-312][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-313][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-314][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-398][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-399][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-400][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-401][^T05-L031]

<a id="mtp-000284"></a>
> [source_metadata] [Printed page 473.][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-400][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-401]

<a id="mtp-000285"></a>
O Lord of Secrets, holder of the vajra!  
In the appearance of the great distinction,  
existence and nonexistence, the two, arise—  
what is called “[retained: སྤྱིས་གཞི], Ground of delusion.”[^T05-038][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-315][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-316][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-317][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-400][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-401][^T05-L042]

<a id="mtp-000286"></a>
Because [it] is mixed with ignorance itself,  
even what is to be known appears as stain.  
Because mindfulness and thinking arise from ordinary mind,  
the essence itself, through conceptual thought—[retained: སྔགས].[^T05-038][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-318][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-319][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-320][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-400][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-401][^T05-L030][^T05-L032]

<a id="mtp-000287"></a>
Because the six mental faculties’ apprehending is unceasing,  
even the dharma embodiment itself is bound by apprehending.  
Because [it] is accompanied by partless particles,  
even clear light itself settles into latency.[^T05-039][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-321][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-322][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-323][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-324][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-400][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-401]

<a id="mtp-000288"></a>
Because the objects of focus of the four conditions are impure,  
appearance itself arises as many.[^T05-039][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-325][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-326][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-400][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-401]

<a id="mtp-000289"></a>
> [source_metadata] [Printed page 474.][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-402][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-403]

<a id="mtp-000290"></a>
Because that very appearance appears as objects,  
wind rests on space, and on that, water;  
with eleven hundred-thousands,  
[it] forms into a rolled sphere.[^T05-040][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-327][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-328][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-329][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-402][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-403][^T05-L033]

<a id="mtp-000291"></a>
As a film forms on milk,  
earth is twelve hundred-thousands;  
the number for wind is a million.[^T05-040][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-330][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-331][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-332][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-402][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-403]

<a id="mtp-000292"></a>
Wind forms, gathers,  
propels, and lifts.  
Water pervades, holds,  
and ripens: these are three.[^T05-041][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-333][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-334][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-402][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-403]

<a id="mtp-000293"></a>
Earth accomplishes, is subtle,  
and is coarse: these are three.[^T05-041][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-335][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-336][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-402][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-403]

<a id="mtp-000294"></a>
As churning turns [milk] into butter,  
Mount Meru, king of mountains,  
with four terraces and a great turret,  
the encircling seas and seven mountains,[^T05-042][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-337][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-338][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-339][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-340][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-402][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-403]

<a id="mtp-000295"></a>
> [source_metadata] [Printed page 475.][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-404][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-405]

<a id="mtp-000296"></a>
the continents and the outer rim take shape.  
These are realms such as the three-thousand [world-system].  
Desire, form, and formlessness—  
the three realms—depend on that.[^T05-042][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-341][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-342][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-343][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-404][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-405]

<a id="mtp-000297"></a>
Not existing, and nothing at all,  
and not the slightest consciousness—  
the formless ones arise from that.[^T05-043][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-344][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-345][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-346][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-404][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-405][^T05-L041]

<a id="mtp-000298"></a>
The embodied ones of the Pure Abodes and the like,  
in the manner of descending from above to below—  
Akaniṣṭha and the like, desire.[^T05-043][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-347][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-348][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-349][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-404][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-405]

<a id="mtp-000299"></a>
For gods and demigods,  
[there is] higher existence; then the three places—  
animals, hungry ghosts, and hell beings;[^T05-043][^CH05-G000994][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-350][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-351][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-352][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-404][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-405][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-406][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-407][^T05-L025]

<a id="mtp-000300"></a>
> [source_metadata] [Printed page 476.][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-406][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-407]

<a id="mtp-000301"></a>
those sentient beings [have] four births.[^T05-043][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-353][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-406][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-407][^T05-L025]

<a id="mtp-000302"></a>
Furthermore, the humans of the first aeon,  
with form, youth, and bodily signs,  
their bodies pervaded by intense light and luster,  
[had] food of merit, such as wish-yielding [food];  
the lifespan of creatures, too, was eighty thousand,  
and there were no male or female organs.[^T05-044][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-354][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-355][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-356][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-357][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-358][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-406][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-407][^T05-L025][^T05-L031][^T05-L005]

<a id="mtp-000303"></a>
Then, from the two causes of delusion,  
afflictions such as desire  
gradually became coarse.  
Gates, such as the faculties, emerged;  
because merit was exhausted, light and the like diminished.[^T05-044][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-359][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-360][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-361][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-362][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-406][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-407][^T05-L026][^T05-L029][^T05-L031][^T05-L034]

<a id="mtp-000304"></a>
Then, gradually, earth-fat[^T05-044][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-363][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-406][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-407][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-408][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-409]

<a id="mtp-000305"></a>
> [source_metadata] [Printed page 477.][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-408][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-409]

<a id="mtp-000306"></a>
and rice and the like were consumed as food.[^T05-044][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-364][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-408][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-409]

<a id="mtp-000307"></a>
Thus, the three worlds themselves—  
five aggregates and five faculties,  
five limbs and five vital organs,  
five objects and five afflictions,  
five ordinary minds, five mental faculties, five conceptual thoughts—  
are established as saṃsāra of apprehended object and apprehending subject.[^T05-045][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-365][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-366][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-367][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-368][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-369][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-370][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-408][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-409][^T05-L026][^T05-L029][^T05-L035]

<a id="mtp-000308"></a>
Delusion’s twofold appearance is like that.  
For example, like a swiftly moving wheel,  
[it] revolves in a connected continuum and abides for a long time.[^T05-045][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-371][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-372][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-373][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-408][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-409]

<a id="mtp-000309"></a>
The various appearances in this way  
are like seeing [retained: སྤྲུལ] from a rope:[^T05-046][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-374][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-408][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-409]

<a id="mtp-000310"></a>
> [source_metadata] [Printed page 478.][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-410][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-411]

<a id="mtp-000311"></a>
by apprehending as that what is not that,  
outer and inner, the environment and its inhabitants, form as two.  
Yet, when examined, [it] is the rope itself;  
the environment and its inhabitants are primordially empty.  
Ultimate and conventional—endowed with form.[^T05-046][^CH05-G001027][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-375][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-376][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-377][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-378][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-379][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-410][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-411]

<a id="mtp-000312"></a>
That seeing of [retained: སྤྲུལ] is true through being seen;  
the rope is true as authentic [reality].  
For example, like a bird abiding on a high place,[^T05-046][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-380][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-381][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-382][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-410][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-411]

<a id="mtp-000313"></a>
the intrinsic nature of the two truths  
is merely worldly convention,  
without relation to authenticity itself.[^T05-047][^CH05-G001032][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-383][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-384][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-397][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-410][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-411]

<a id="mtp-000314"></a>
From the basic space of emptiness,  
all is liberated as its essence.  
Since awareness, empty and clear, pervades greatly,  
the inhabitants are gathered into the core itself.[^T05-047][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-385][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-386][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-387][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-388][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-410][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-411][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-412][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-413][^T05-L036][^T05-L037]

<a id="mtp-000315"></a>
> [source_metadata] [Printed page 479.][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-412][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-413]

<a id="mtp-000316"></a>
There, in that very core,  
the five embodiments and five primordial knowings,  
five lights, five aspects of color,  
five phenomena, five winds of primordial knowing,  
five essences and five intrinsic natures—  
with five compassionate responsivenesses, [it] pervades all.[^T05-048][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-389][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-390][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-391][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-392][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-393][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-412][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-413][^T05-L027][^T05-L031][^T05-L036]

<a id="mtp-000317"></a>
There is no mindfulness, nor movement itself;  
in the magical display of the basic space of phenomena,  
all is gathered into its state.  
One and two are the unique [one].”[^T05-048][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-394][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-395][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-396][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-412][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-413]

<a id="mtp-000318"></a>
> [chapter_colophon] Thus, from the precious secret tantra String of Pearls,[^T05-049][^CH05-G001049][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-412][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-413][^MTP-AUDIT-C05-415]
